title: Real-estate record statement: one transaction, parcel or price-index observation as a publisher released it
description: One statement a Geospatial real-estate adapter emits (HM Land Registry Price Paid Data and UK HPI, DGFiP/Etalab DVF, Eurostat prc_hpi_q, INSPIRE cadastral parcels through the WFS path) and src.kb.real_estate keeps as an immutable revision with its release vintage. Publisher corrections and deletions are revisions (PPD C/D rows, DVF mutations changed or absent in a later release), never overwrites. A parcel references its geometry in the Geospatial stores (feature, geometry, source CRS, transform) and never copies it. No statement carries an owner, buyer, seller or party name, a valuation, a price estimate, an apportioned, converted or interpolated price, or advice.

as_published.description: transaction: source_transaction_id, price (money), transfer_date, property_type/tenure/category (PPD) or nature_mutation, locals, lot_counts, parcel_ids (DVF), address(es), record_status; parcel: local_id, inspire_namespace, inspire_id, national_cadastral_reference, reference_scheme, label, area_m2, valid_from, geometry {feature_id, geometry_id, source_crs, source_geometry_sha256, coordinate_transform}; price_index_observation: index_id, dataset, measure, geography {scheme, code, label}, period, value, unit, base_period, edition, flags
